facts.value: Bachelor of Software Engineering, Swinburne University of Technology, 2022–2025
The resume summary says 4 years of software engineering experience and 3 years of AI and machine-learning delivery.

sections.heading: Axion Solutions
sections.text: Axion Solutions. AI Software Engineer, July 2026 to present. He owns the AI vision, the product strategy, and the operating model for Axis. FoodFlow is the multi-tenant food-distribution ERP and the system of record, covering sales, purchasing, inventory, production, finance, and delivery scheduling. Axis is a separate product for Studio copilot, data insight, and message drafting. It calls typed tools on FoodFlow, shows a preview, and waits for a person to approve a write. Axis does not own FoodFlow's database. The engine uses LangChain and LangGraph. Modular actions, connectors, scoring, review gates, and version-controlled pipelines assemble the work. LangSmith and OpenTelemetry cover the traces. Human approval gates and audit trails govern execution. The resume also uses the phrase capital-markets automation for investment and growth workflows. That phrase does not rename FoodFlow. The word production in that list is a business module, not a release. Own the AI vision, product strategy and operating model for Axis, a capital-markets automation platform that converts complex investment and growth workflows into governed, reusable AI automation.

sections.heading: Axion workflow engine
sections.text: Axion workflow engine. A governed graph platform in the Engine monorepo, separate from FoodFlow. The recipes are startup scouting, investor scouting, and portfolio reporting. Startup scouting searches a list and public profiles with Apollo, Seamless, Tavily, and web crawling, then scores and exports. That export does not send a message. Investor scouting builds a people list so a startup can look for investors. One recipe starts from a saved persona. Portfolio reporting writes company updates as versioned artifacts. The draft recipe does not send email. A separate recipe emails founders. Those recipes are not capital-markets products. Axis can draft on the same host. Axis does not own the Engine database or FoodFlow's data.

sections.heading: Shipped work
sections.text: Shipped work. FoodFlow uses the word production for a business module, not for a release. The record does not say FoodFlow is in a customer production environment. Named live or sold work: CVA has a live app, HA Manager was sold, WritingJourney was sold, the roster app was sold, the golf scanner was sold, and SkyLedge was acquired. A sale or an acquisition is not a production release. CVA is the only named live app.

sections.heading: Harry the Hirer, Senior AI Engineer
sections.text: Harry the Hirer, Senior AI Engineer. Melbourne, December 2025 to July 2026. He led the AI work for event inventory, logistics, planning, and documents. The resume calls the company Australia's largest event enterprise. The stack includes Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph, and FastAPI. A multi-agent layer uses Planner, Retriever, Verifier, Critic, and Tool-Executor agents. Answers are citation-grounded, and a person stays in the loop. Retrieval uses agentic chunking, query decomposition, BM25 and HNSW hybrid search, metadata filters, and cross-encoder reranking. Validators check that an answer stays on the evidence. The resume records about 40 percent less repetitive lookup and drafting in targeted pilot workflows, and 99.9 percent operational uptime. OCR and document extraction use Pydantic contracts, constrained JSON, and MCP-style access to stock and planning data. Services run in Docker with MSAL authentication. Spearheaded AI transformation for Australia's largest event enterprise, converting inventory, logistics, planning and document-heavy workflows into production AI systems using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph, FastAPI and governed human-in-the-loop operations. Architected a multi-agent RAG orchestration layer with Planner, Retriever, Verifier, Critic and Tool-Executor agents, combining graph-state workflows, function/tool routing, citation-grounded generation, HITL approvals, LangSmith-style traces/evals and OpenTelemetry-style observability for audit-ready planning decisions. Optimized latency, token spend and throughput through dynamic multi-LLM routing, context pruning, sliding-window memory, KV-cache-aware prompting, async batching, regex patternization, structured output repair and automated replanning, reducing repetitive lookup/drafting effort by ~40% in targeted pilot workflows.

sections.heading: Harry the Hirer, pedigree AI
sections.text: Harry the Hirer, pedigree AI. March 2026 to May 2026. Thoroughbred pedigree AI for the Black Caviar lineage platform, in an ML and data science role. It is a mate-selection engine for genetic merit, compatibility, and inbreeding risk. The resume describes a 10-signal ensemble: matrix factorization, GBM temporal ranking, VAE genetic fingerprints, Bayesian nicking, Dosage Theory, and a Shared Ancestor Compatibility Kernel. It uses 64-dimensional pedigree embeddings, graph expansion, temporal splits against leakage, and LLM explanations. Built on the legacy pedigree platform behind world-champion Black Caviar, reimagining thoroughbred pedigree intelligence as an AI-first mate-selection engine that balances genetic merit, compatibility and inbreeding risk. Engineered a 10-signal hybrid ensemble for bipartite ranking across matrix factorization, GBM temporal ranking, VAE genetic fingerprints, Bayesian nicking, modernized Dosage Theory and a Shared Ancestor Compatibility Kernel.

sections.heading: Mizco
sections.text: Mizco, AI Team Lead. Perth, November 2025 to June 2026. He led a trust-first platform that turns RFQ text into governed industrial artefacts for compliance-sensitive work. The resume records about 50 percent less manual review and artefact preparation in the targeted workflows. Inference uses vLLM, agent routing, constrained JSON, and ReAct tool calling behind FastAPI. A Next.js cockpit shows traces, confidence gates, and validation. The pipelines read PDF, DOCX, and XLSX. A person reviews uncertain output. Engineered local-LLM inference with vLLM serving, agent routing, dynamic model selection, constrained JSON, ReAct/tool calling, batch execution, caching and FastAPI orchestration, balancing latency, cost and reasoning depth across RFQ analysis tasks. Built a Next.js operations cockpit with OpenTelemetry-style traces, structured logs, confidence gates, semantic sanitization, validation suites and concurrency-aware tool execution to make agent behavior observable, testable and executive-reviewable. Implemented IDP/ETL standardization, long-context RAG memory, self-correction, backfill/recovery loops and HITL escalation to prevent false completeness, surface uncertainty and maintain deterministic output consistency across PDF/DOCX/XLSX corpora.

sections.heading: Teqar
sections.text: Teqar, AI Development Consultant. Perth, May 2025 to present. Advises B2B clients on AI transformation, from workflow maps to staged delivery plans. The scope includes analytics, vision quality checks, chat, and data pipelines. Scope predictive analytics, computer vision quality assurance, automation architectures and data-pipeline modernization initiatives that turn operational metrics into measurable productivity gains and defensible competitive advantages.

sections.heading: Swinburne research
sections.text: Swinburne research. Researcher at Swinburne University of Technology, Melbourne, August 2025 to July 2026. Liam led a clinical AI lab of five people. The lab is MedSwin. It built specialist medical agents and a reasoning orchestrator. Fine-tuning used distillation, LoRA, and QLoRA on more than 500,000 curated cases. A project line also cites 5 million synthetic cases. Both figures are resume wording, and they are not the same count. Agentic retrieval covers clinical records and PubMed, with safety guardrails. An 8-million-document biomedical reranker feeds the orchestrator. The resume records 86 percent BERTScore on MedMCQA, PubMedQA, and MedQuAD. Built agentic RAG over EMR/EHR and PubMed with safety guardrails; trained an 8M-document biomedical reranker integrated into MAC, achieving 86% BERTScore across MedMCQA, PubMedQA and MedQuAD.

sections.heading: AITC
sections.text: AITC, Senior AI Engineer. June 2025 to November 2025. He led an industrial assistant that uses LLMs, NLP, and OCR to turn unstructured PDFs into operational guidance. He owned ingestion, preprocessing, deployment, and optimisation, and he mentored data engineers. The resume names partner work with Nvidia, HPA, IBM, Juniper, and Cisco Vietnam. Architected and led an industrial AI assistant combining LLMs, NLP and OCR/IDP to transform unstructured PDFs into actionable operational guidance, document intelligence and business-ready knowledge workflows. Owned ingestion, preprocessing, deployment and optimization while mentoring data engineers and scaling production AI capabilities for strategic partners including Nvidia, HPA, IBM, Juniper and Cisco Vietnam.

sections.heading: Hai Au Academy
sections.text: Hai Au Academy. AI Software Engineer, August 2025 to October 2025, Binh Duong. HA Manager is the bilingual student-management platform, sold to Hai Au Group. It covers enrollment, placement testing, scheduling, and attendance. The resume records about 35 percent less admin effort. Delivered a bilingual student-management platform across enrollment, class scheduling, placement testing, attendance, reporting dashboards and RBAC using a modern web stack with API-driven modules for multi-campus school operations. Delivered a bilingual school-operations platform consolidating enrollment, placement testing, class scheduling, attendance, reporting and administration into a role-based system for students, staff and multi-campus operators. Integrated MCP-enabled chatbot workflows with human approval plus Vietnamese/English NLP helpers for translation, homework support and routine administration, reducing manual work while preserving operational control and data integrity.

sections.heading: Pythera
sections.text: Pythera, AI LLM Engineer. January 2025 to September 2025. Clara is a Vietnamese medical language and vision model. The resume records more than 400,000 cases, more than 210,000 imaging studies, recall above 95 percent, and precision above 92 percent on labelled sets. Clara was adopted by 175 Hospital in Ho Chi Minh City. Liam is a contributor, not the sole author.

sections.heading: PopTech
sections.text: PopTech, ML Engineer. Melbourne, May 2025 to July 2025. Liam led a four-person team on an IoT electricity forecasting and control platform. The pipelines check sensor quality, impute gaps, and watch for drift. The models include TFT, XGBoost, and DQN, with an LLM advisory path and speech input for billing and energy recommendations. Integrated TFT, XGBoost, DQN and LLM advisory interfaces with multimodal ASR/TTS support to power predictive billing, automated energy recommendations and control-loop decision support for IoT devices.

sections.heading: Nam A Bank, AI and data
sections.text: Nam A Bank, AI and data. Nam Á Bank, AI and Data Engineer, Ho Chi Minh City, December 2024 to May 2025. OCR, computer vision, and language-model research for passport and remittance documents. The public work trains VietOCR on synthetic passports. The pipelines use OpenCV and structured extraction for foreign-customer onboarding. Built fintech AI/data capabilities across OCR, computer vision, LLM/chatbot workflows and product analytics, including passport OCR, synthetic data generation and document-intelligence pipelines for faster foreign-customer onboarding and remittance expansion analysis.

sections.heading: Nam A Bank, software
sections.text: Nam A Bank, software. Nam Á Bank, Software Engineer, April 2023 to June 2024. Banking modules in Java, including Vert.x services and Android screens. The services use REST and asynchronous requests, with authentication on the customer data path. Engineered banking software components across Vert.x backend services and Java Android modules, improving secure API integration, mobile service access, customer onboarding flows and reliability of digital banking feature delivery. Supported production-grade software delivery through RESTful service design, asynchronous request handling, authentication-aware data flows, mobile UI improvements, web-service performance tuning and cross-team debugging across high-compliance fintech workflows.

sections.heading: iNet Solution
sections.text: iNet Solution, Software and Data Scientist. Ho Chi Minh City, April 2024 to March 2025. An LLM pipeline over news text for sentiment, fact-checking, and summarisation. The stack is Obsei and Transformers. Led an LLM-powered analytics pipeline for sentiment analysis, fact-checking and summarization using Obsei, Transformers and cloud architecture to generate business insights from large document/article collections.

sections.heading: VietDan, water meters
sections.text: VietDan, water meters. ML Engineer at VietDan JSC, December 2024 to February 2025. Water-meter OCR on more than 10,000 samples. The resume records about 35 percent less manual work. Deployment used Jetson and AWS.

sections.heading: VietDan, cloud
sections.text: VietDan, cloud. Cloud Software Engineer at VietDan JSC, June 2022 to March 2023. AWS IoT and machine-learning services.

sections.heading: Alta Media
sections.text: Alta Media, DevOps Cloud Engineer. May 2022 to January 2023. AWS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.

sections.heading: Tien Thanh Co
sections.text: Tien Thanh Co, IoT and Software Engineer. Ho Chi Minh City, January 2020 to August 2020. Engineered cloud-ready IoT and software services across AWS and Azure, containerizing APIs and device-data workloads with Docker/Kubernetes while supporting deployment automation, monitoring and scalable service delivery for production operations.

sections.heading: Swinburne University of Technology
sections.text: Swinburne University of Technology. Bachelor of Software Engineering, Melbourne, 2022 to 2025.

sections.heading: MedSwin
sections.text: MedSwin. Swinburne-funded multi-agent clinical AI. Liam led a five-person lab that built specialist medical agents and a reasoning orchestrator. Fine-tuning used distillation, LoRA, and QLoRA. Agentic retrieval covers clinical records and PubMed. An 8-million-document biomedical reranker feeds the orchestrator. The resume records 86 percent BERTScore on MedMCQA, PubMedQA, and MedQuAD. Hugging Face org MedSwin hosts the models. The resume says the models were among Australia's most downloaded AI models in November and December 2025. That download rank is resume wording and was not re-counted here.

sections.heading: MedVietAI
sections.text: MedVietAI. Liam is the founder of this non-profit effort toward a sovereign Vietnamese medical language model. It extends the MedSwin architecture for Vietnamese language and healthcare context. The resume says Vietnam's National Data Association sponsored the initiative. The resume also defines a vision for EMR-based monitoring. The Hugging Face org is MedVietAI. Defines the vision for secure national-scale medical data acquisition, EMR-driven proactive health monitoring, personalized clinical insights and rural/peak-hour decision support, positioning Vietnam to build sovereign AI capability for healthcare and public-good innovation.

sections.heading: Codoptic
sections.text: Codoptic. Open-source coding agent. It reads a repository, plans an implementation, and can generate or review code. It also turns a repository into interactive DSL diagrams so a developer can navigate the architecture. Public repository: github.com/Codoptic/Codoptic. Built a customizable community coding agent for repository understanding, workflow automation, skill/tool orchestration, code generation, review and implementation planning across user-defined engineering workflows. Added repo-to-interactive-DSL diagram generation so complex codebases can be converted into navigable architecture maps, accelerating onboarding, documentation and system reasoning for developers.

sections.heading: Clinical triage response
sections.text: Clinical triage response. Speech uses Whisper. Clinical reasoning uses Gemini. Vision uses Qwen-VL. The triage data is MIMIC-IV. The portals use React Native and React, with FastAPI streaming and FAISS plus MongoDB retrieval. A Great Shark 330 PRO VTOL drone is the medication-delivery path. Repository: Lelekhoa1812/Triage-LLM-Based. Space: huggingface.co/spaces/khoaliamle/Triage_LLM.

sections.heading: SkyLedge fleet maintenance
sections.text: SkyLedge fleet maintenance. Liam led a four-person capstone team on an OBD-II platform. The resume says SkyLedge Kenya acquired it. Telemetry comes from a Raspberry Pi into FastAPI. Fault prediction uses K-means, XGBoost, Random Forest, and LSTM. The servicing-cost figure is an estimate of about 15 percent.

sections.heading: Sall-e
sections.text: Sall-e. Autonomous robot for oceanic garbage collection. The resume says Liam led a software team of five. The robot uses computer vision, sensor fusion, and navigation to detect and localise waste. Perception uses CNN and Transformer models, with object tracking and route planning. Repository: Lelekhoa1812/Sall-e. The record does not include a download count for the garbage-classification dataset. Directed data mining, self-training CNN/Transformer perception, object tracking, sensor-stream processing and AI-assisted route planning to improve detection reliability, adaptive movement and autonomous collection decisions in dynamic water environments.

sections.heading: Golf scorecard scanner
sections.text: Golf scorecard scanner. Sold to VHandicap. The resume records about 15 percent efficiency gain. Field detection uses YOLOv8 and YOLOv11. Text extraction uses VietOCR and PaddleOCR. Handwriting uses MNIST and CTC. Qwen2.5-VL checks handwritten corrections.

sections.heading: CVA
sections.text: CVA. A career application agent. A planner agent scores role fit and drafts a CV and a cover letter. A reviewer agent critiques the draft, and a person approves it. The run keeps profile memory and document versions. Repository: Lelekhoa1812/CVA. Live app: cva-mauve.vercel.app. Built a multi-agent job-application assistant that captures strengths, preferences and achievements, plans application strategy, generates tailored CVs/resumes/cover letters and preserves checkpoint memory for role-specific personalization. The app is built with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, MongoDB and NVIDIA NIM.

sections.heading: WritingJourney
sections.text: WritingJourney. The resume says version 1.5.0 was sold to Hai Au Group. It is an IELTS, PTE, and TOEIC writing coach. It scores a submission, explains the error, and plans the rewrite. A person stays in control of the result. Implemented rubric-aware evaluation, error clustering, revision planning and feedback generation to help learners understand why writing fails, how to improve coherence and how to practice toward measurable band-score gains.

sections.heading: Roster management
sections.text: Roster management. The resume says this product was sold to MJ Industrial Australia. It is a Kotlin Android app with a Node.js backend and a MariaDB database for rostering, payroll, shift tracking, and payment processing at a Melbourne warehouse. Repository: Lelekhoa1812/RosterManagement. The resume does not list a separate Android employment at MJ Industrial. Built role-based workflows, attendance capture, roster validation and payroll-ready reporting so warehouse managers could reduce scheduling errors, accelerate payment reconciliation and improve operational visibility.

sections.heading: Ericsson 5G digital twin
sections.text: Ericsson 5G digital twin. The resume says Ericsson Vietnam and Swinburne funded this predictive-maintenance platform. The resume calls the build production-grade, and it is not a named live customer app. It reads tower telemetry, forecasts bandwidth pressure, and detects degradation. The stack is C# .NET, MySQL, and ONNX Runtime. Forecasting uses a spatio-temporal graph model and a temporal fusion transformer. Anomaly detection uses an autoencoder. Drift monitoring uses the population stability index. The record does not include a deployment count. Built multithreaded ETL, indexed time-series schemas, ST-GCN/TFT forecasting, deep autoencoder anomaly detection, Weibull survival modeling and PSI-based drift monitoring to support proactive maintenance and low-latency model serving inside .NET services.

sections.heading: ADHD Assistant
sections.text: ADHD Assistant. The resume describes a Nvidia NIM helper for daily routines and planning. It uses voice or text, breaks a task down, and checks progress. The record does not include a user count or a clinical outcome. Built voice/text helper agents for daily routines, activity planning and reflective check-ins, using Nvidia NIM-aligned architecture to adapt communication style, task breakdown and follow-up support. Designed context-aware reminders, conversational planning flows, adaptive task decomposition and progress checkpoints to help users translate intentions into manageable daily actions without overwhelming cognitive load.

sections.heading: MedChat
sections.text: MedChat. The resume calls this a prototype. It is a multilingual medical conversation agent with a planner, specialist routing, source ranking, safety filters, and citation checks. The resume does not describe it as a deployed clinical system. Built a medical conversation prototype using multilingual web-crawled sources, a multi-agent planner, diagnostics-specialist routing, retrieval validation, clinical guardrails and citation-aware generation. Combined source ranking, safety filters, evidence checking and specialist answer synthesis to support multilingual health Q&A with clearer provenance, reduced hallucination risk and more transparent clinical-response boundaries.

sections.heading: S&P 500 forecast
sections.text: S&P 500 forecast. The resume describes a multi-horizon system. It uses temporal fusion transformers, graph networks, FinBERT on news and SEC filings, and a reinforcement-learning agent for portfolio execution. Training uses combinatorial purged cross-validation, and drift detection can trigger a retrain. The data path uses Apache Kafka. Public repository: Lelekhoa1812/S-P500_Prediction_Model. The record does not include a return figure. Developed a multi-horizon quantitative system using Temporal Fusion Transformers, Graph Neural Networks, FinBERT news/SEC-filing sentiment and Deep Reinforcement Learning agents for dynamic portfolio execution and alpha generation. Built leakage-resistant infrastructure with fractional differentiation, Combinatorial Purged and Embargoed CV, Apache Kafka streaming and concept-drift detection to preserve market memory and trigger retraining during regime shifts.

sections.heading: EstateFolio
sections.text: EstateFolio. The resume describes a price forecast for homes in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi. A spatio-temporal graph network, an ST-GNN, models links between districts. A transformer reads listing text, bond updates, and regulatory notes. Drift detection is part of the pipeline. The record does not include an error rate.

sections.heading: Public repositories
sections.text: Public repositories. Selected work on github.com/Lelekhoa1812. Prophet is a time-series agent. free-router is an OpenAI-compatible router for Gemini, OpenRouter, and NVIDIA. Survee is an agentic survey tool. stt-studio is local Whisper inference. Quotient takes meeting notes. AgentDiagram turns a diagram into code with more than one agent. Medical-Chatbot-RAG answers general medical questions from retrieved text. Acnt-MCP is an accounting assistant. Also public, with no production claim: prompt-me refines a prompt before a model call, undercut is a junior-developer assistant, StudyBuddy is an agentic study assistant, and Cooking-Tutor is a cooking tutor that uses web search. The record does not include star counts, users, or revenue for these repositories. The visitor page lists the full public archive. This section names a selection only.

sections.heading: Hugging Face models
sections.text: Hugging Face models. Public model cards on huggingface.co/khoaliamle. The names are MNIST numeric recognition, a CTC MNIST model, graffiti detection, Vietnamese passport field recognition, an S&P 500 series, water-meter segmentation, rust detection, garbage detection, garbage classification, driver behaviour from OBD, and fuel efficiency from OBD. Public datasets on the same account include a synthetic passport set, a garbage-classification set, a Vietnamese golf scorecard set, and medical question sets. A public Space is not a production release. The record does not include an accuracy, a dataset size, or a download count for these models or datasets.

sections.heading: Water-meter scanner
sections.text: Water-meter scanner. ML work for VietDan JSC, December 2024 to February 2025. It reads meter photos so staff enter fewer readings. The resume records about 35 percent less manual meter processing, on more than 10,000 samples. The resume says the scanner was productionized, and it is not a named public app. Deployment used Jetson and AWS. The record does not include a site count. Repository: Lelekhoa1812/Water-Meter-Scanner.

sections.heading: Passport OCR
sections.text: Passport OCR. Nam A Bank work, December 2024 to May 2025, for passport and remittance documents. The public repository trains VietOCR on synthetic passports. The record does not include a download count for the synthetic passport dataset. Repository: Lelekhoa1812/Vietnamese-Passport-OCR-Project-with-VietOCR. Built fintech AI/data capabilities across OCR, computer vision, LLM/chatbot workflows and product analytics, including passport OCR, synthetic data generation and document-intelligence pipelines for faster foreign-customer onboarding and remittance expansion analysis.

sections.heading: free-router
sections.text: free-router. A self-hosted OpenAI-compatible gateway. The repository names Google AI Studio, Nvidia NIM, OpenRouter, and Mistral among the providers. It is a Next.js service. Repository: Lelekhoa1812/free-router. The record does not include a user count.

sections.heading: stt-studio
sections.text: stt-studio. A local speech-to-text workspace for a Mac. A FastAPI service runs faster-whisper, and a React page reviews the transcript. The repository calls it a development project, not a packaged production app. Repository: Lelekhoa1812/stt-studio. The record does not include a user count.

sections.heading: Prophet
sections.text: Prophet. A research prototype that answers a spreadsheet question in plain language and keeps the steps behind each number. Forecasts use TimesFM. The store is SQLite. Repository: Lelekhoa1812/prophet. The record does not include an accuracy figure or a user count. Each forecast is backtested against simple baselines on your own history, so you can see whether the model beats a naive guess. The server listens on loopback only, and your uploaded files stay local.

sections.heading: Survee
sections.text: Survee. A host-run interview tool, previously called KQA. A person uploads an HTML questionnaire and sends a private link. Answers stay in MongoDB. It does not score people. Repository: Lelekhoa1812/survee. The record does not include a user count.

sections.heading: Quotient
sections.text: Quotient. It turns a recorded meeting into a brief. Each published statement points to the moment in the recording. A statement it cannot confirm is held for review. The repository calls it a local pre-release, not a deployed product. Repository: Lelekhoa1812/Quotient. The record does not include a user count.

sections.heading: Acnt-MCP
sections.text: Acnt-MCP. An accounting assistant over OpenCollective and exchange-rate data. Repository: Lelekhoa1812/Acnt-MCP. The record does not include a user count.

sections.heading: Skills
sections.text: Skills. Languages: Vietnamese native, English fluent, Mandarin intermediate. The resume groups the stack as agents, retrieval, cloud platforms, software, machine learning, and document AI. Named tools include Python, Java, TypeScript, C#, SQL, React, Next.js, Vue, Node.js, FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LlamaIndex, MCP, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, Nvidia NIM, vLLM, Docker, Kubernetes, LoRA, OCR, Salesforce Agentforce, Kafka, MLflow, and pgvector. The record does not name one metric that Liam measures after a model is live.
